articles.title: Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
articles.title_zh: Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.22564v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits.
